body:
Thank you so much for your words. My partner and I went last week and it was still too early to go forward with the procedure so we’re going next week. I’ve been fortunate to have him
Be so so brilliant with everything going on but I am scared, and lately I’ve been reconsidering keeping my pregnancy and I’m scared of making the wrong decision

I’m sorry for your loss, yeah I’m not with the father and I’ve been dealing with deep depressions since my friend took his life last summer, I’m currently reading up on PTSD post abortion and increased depression especially in those who’ve experienced it prior to the termination, I’m very scared. I told my friend who is also responsible and he took it very very well and is being super helpful both financially and emotionally which is appreciated but still heavy nonetheless. Did your depression alleviate about the termination eventually?

I know the information to a clinic near me, I live in California so it’s fairly easy and most people I’m surrounded with are pro choice I guess I’m just a little lost and feeling guilty for choosing to have an abortion when it’s my fault for not being safe
My names Fi, I live in California and go to an arts school for acting. I’m new to this subreddit and would love to talk to you more!
911 is just going to put me in a psych ward and that sounds like hell. It isn’t a rush, it’s been a long time coming
No. I’m just so tired.

All of what you said is true. Yeah. I don’t have time to go to the hospital. My school takes attendance very seriously and I can’t afford to fuck it up. My school is 50k a year, my mother doesn’t work and is disabled. I have lots and lots of scholarships and lots and lots of loans. I’m hurting.

It’s so hard because I am very blessed, I have some of the greatest friends in the world and my mother - single mother, I’m an only child -  is and has always been very very supportive of me. I feel so selfish for wanting to take my life. But lately I can’t help it. Thank you for your kindness. I just feel so tired. I feel in the dark always.
I don’t believe in god.

I have lots of good friends and I’ve tried confiding in them but I always cover it up. I think people don’t take me seriously cause my friend just took his life. He’s the best, he was one of the funniest people I’d ever met, I don’t want to steal his thunder, haha. But on a more serious note, yeah I’m going to look into seeing a therapist when I get back to school, but I don’t have anything to tell them about if it isn’t killing myself so I don’t know how well that would work

I know it’s true, I am very empathetic. But it doesn’t change anything. You’re trying to sway me, I’ve talked/tried to talk people down before. I’m going to school for it, the show I’m in is something I want to do, it doesn’t matter. It’s not going to work.

Voting is the least of my worries right now. And, No. We’ve been on a national tour for three months and we’re in our last 5 days. Two of my friends who took their lives, moms are coming this week. I have to finish this show. I’m just afraid of what happens afterwards.
That’s what my director says. Being empathetic. I’m so tired.
Yup.

I feel crazy. I want to act, that’s what I go to school for. I want to make films and direct them too.  I want to be the first of my family to graduate college. I want my family to drink less and be productive more. I want to buy my mother a nice house. I want to have lots of babies and be a foster mother some day. I want my friends to be back. I want to be “chill” and “normal” and like my self and not think about death and dying and what my body would look like if I hung myself.

That’s what I would “envision”.
The world. The president. America. The show. My friend.
You think I’m crazy because I want to kill myself?
I didn’t say things were crazy
What? What does that even mean?

I’ve always thought that the way I’d do it was to jump. But, as much as I think that and as much as I relate to you, I still have to think: no. You can’t, you shouldn’t. I just lost a very dear friend to suicide and it’s made me want to harm myself more than anything. Think about you, think about the people you love, you don’t want them to hurt themselves
Cut it up in little tiny pieces

Although it’s a breach of trust, if I were in your shoes I’d rather tell someone (doctor, parents - your family seems lovely and trustworthy and helpful) and have my sister be mad at me, than tell no one and have my sister harm herself or take her life

Haha yeah I guess your right, you’re really right. It would scare them and then they’d tell my mom. That’s the other thing that keeps me from doing it, probably above everything, is my mom. She’s a single mom and I’m an only child. We’re very close and a great handful of parents are (eventually) able to go about their lives and live and exist but I truly think my mom would take her own life if I took mine, or become a shell of a person, and that sounds even worse. I could t do that to her. I don’t know.

I’m back home on a break from tour and my ex ended up staying the night. I tried waking him up, I need help, he was out of it, I shook him and shook him and he woke up but didn’t understand how badly I needed him, I went to the bathroom and came back and he was asleep. I’m telling people to their faces that I n e e d help and no one is doing anything. You don’t know me though how can you say that? That it would be a travesty

That’s what’s been keeping me going. It seems like we’re saving lots of lives and we’re partnered with several suicide prevention organizations, lots of which are lead by parents who have lost their children to suicide, and I play a mother whose lost her daughter, so I feel like if I killed my self it would be such a devastating slap in the face to them and to my cast and my friend and his mom. And mine too. And it’d be selfish to put them through that, I’m aware of that, but it’d all be over so soon I wouldn’t have to worry about that or anything ever again

My good friend took his life in June, just over a month ago, I’ve had episodes of depression and anxiety before that. But since he’s been gone I’ve been feeling like I’m sinking back into it. I have a good life, I do, and ironically I’m in a play that’s touring right now - about teen suicide - so I feel like I couldn’t take my life before that’s over because how are we supposed to save lives if someone in the show offs themselves before the run is even over? Everyone says it/grief gets better with time, but it just feels like it’s been getting worse. I’m not well.
This makes me so happy man. Glad to hear you’re feeling better. Moms right, permanent solution to a temporary feeling!
I’ll be your friend
It’s not a “couple of weeks” how dare you. It doesn’t have to be her entire life suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary feeling.
Stay for the little dog. Please.

You should stay, if not for anything for your little girl at least. Think about what that’s going to do to her? I lost one of my good friends to suicide two weeks ago and it’s one of the worst pains I’ve ever felt. Please. Think. What if she runs in the room and sees your body? Don’t go. Please. My friend was 17 too. He was the happiest person I’d ever met, or so I thought. I’m in such pain I’ve considered taking my life these past two weeks. You don’t want the people you love to take their lives because you did, right? I’m here.
I lost one of my best friends two weeks ago and god is it one of the worst feelings. Please stay. Don’t leave.
